Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Energy personnel, researchers, national laboratories, institutions of higher education, and private fusion industry partners.
dimensions.evidence: Director shall consult with the private sector, National Laboratories, institutions of higher education, and the public

dimensions.assessment: Reestablishes a dedicated office and consolidates existing fusion programs under a new Director reporting to the Secretary of Energy.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall establish the Office of Fusion... within the Department

dimensions.assessment: Transfers existing programs and structures within the Department of Energy but does not state new spending amounts or appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: transfer all programs previously stewarded by the Fusion Energy Sciences program... to the Office

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Department of Energy Organization Act to create a new office, outline its purposes and director role, and require commercial deployment roadmaps.
dimensions.evidence: Title II of the Department of Energy Organization Act is amended by inserting after section 215... the following: 'Sec. 216. Office of Fusion.'

dimensions.assessment: Creates a permanent organizational office and mandates ongoing periodic reporting roadmaps every four years.
dimensions.evidence: submit to Congress an updated roadmap... every 4 years

missing_information: Specific funding or budget allocations assigned specifically to the new Office of Fusion
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Department of Energy Organization Act to reestablish an Office of Fusion to advance fusion energy science, consolidate existing fusion programs, and manage public-private partnerships.
